diagram_previews.alt: First-quadrant lattice grid with x from 0 to 5 and y from 0 to 6. The red dashed line 20x + 17y = 100 runs from (0, 100/17) to (5,0); the 20 lattice points strictly below it, including those on the axes, are large blue dots and the other grid points are small grey dots.
